papers.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
papers.takeaway: We introduce three key elements that allow us to achieve state-of-the-art visual quality while maintaining competitive training times and importantly allow high-quality real-time (≥ 30 fps) novel-view synthesis at 1080p resolution.

papers.title: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian splatting
papers.takeaway: Considering the rapid changes and growing number of works in this field, we present a literature review of recent 3D Gaussian splatting methods, which can be roughly classified by functionality into 3D reconstruction, 3D editing, and other downstream applications.

papers.title: A Survey on 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.takeaway: 3D Gaussian splatting (GS) has emerged as a transformative technique in radiance fields.

papers.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting as a New Era: A Survey
papers.takeaway: Given the growing popularity and expanding research in 3D-GS, this paper presents a comprehensive survey of relevant papers from the past year.

papers.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting: Survey, Technologies, Challenges, and Opportunities
papers.takeaway: Based on these analyses, we further examine the common challenges and technologies across various tasks, proposing potential research opportunities.
